actions.action: Merge changes against the tab’s original revision
actions.mechanism: Three-way comparison distinguishes independent edits from fields changed differently in both versions; edit timestamps do not determine precedence.
actions.implementation: Retain base values and revision. On stale-save rejection, fetch current values, merge independent changes into a draft, and flag divergent fields.
actions.check: Test a stale tab edited after another tab saved: independent changes survive; divergent changes require resolution.
actions.risk: Missing base values must trigger explicit comparison, not guessing.

actions.action: Resolve conflicting fields inside the editor
actions.mechanism: Field-specific comparisons let users resolve disagreements without moving text between windows.
actions.implementation: Show base, your version, and saved version for conflicts only. Provide editable text combinations and explicit single-choice selection; retain alternatives. Require separate publishing.
actions.check: Resolve text and choice conflicts using keyboard controls in one tab; verify nonconflicting edits remain untouched and nothing publishes automatically.
actions.risk: Truncated previews can conceal differences; provide complete expandable values.

actions.action: Keep recoverable versions through conflict resolution
actions.mechanism: A version shelf preserves displaced text even after users choose another version or reload.
actions.implementation: Persist tab-specific drafts before saves and resolutions. Archive both text alternatives with document, field, and revision identifiers; provide in-editor restore or append controls.
actions.check: Choose saved text over local text, reload, then recover the complete local text without copying between windows.
actions.risk: Sensitive drafts need retention controls; storage failure must block destructive transitions.

actions.action: Show revision changes before users attempt saving
actions.mechanism: Cross-tab revision notifications identify potentially affected fields without replacing local work or trusting edit recency.
actions.implementation: Broadcast document ID and revision after saving. Receiving tabs fetch that revision and mark changed fields; retain server stale-save rejection as authoritative.
actions.check: With notifications delivered and suppressed, verify newer local edits survive and stale saves still enter resolution; unresolved drafts never publish.
actions.risk: Notifications can be missed; badges must not imply save permission.
